name: Scaffold-Spider

Traits.name: Spider Climb
Traits.text: The scaffold-spider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

Traits.name: Nimble Skitter
Traits.text: The scaffold-spider ignores Difficult Terrain, and Opportunity Attacks against it are made with Disadvantage.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The scaffold-spider makes three attacks, using Scaffold-Spear or Scrap-Slinger in any combination.

Actions.name: Scaffold-Spear
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. 14 (3d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

Actions.name: Scrap-Slinger
Actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, range 30/120 ft. 14 (4d4 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

Actions.name: Cable Stone (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.text: The scaffold-spider hurls cable-wrapped stone at a point it can see within 90 feet. *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 14, each creature in a 5-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point. *Failure:* 42 (12d6) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it has the Prone condition. *Success:* Half damage.

Bonus Actions.name: Fleet Agility
Bonus Actions.text: The scaffold-spider takes the Dash or Disengage action.

lore: Spun into being in the rafters of half-finished towers, it binds itself to the beams above a worksite and kills the builders below one net at a time, hoarding their tools on its ceiling as trophies.

generation.userConcept: a scaffold-spider that fights from the ceiling and never comes down

monsterDescription: a scaffold-spider that fights from the ceiling and never comes down
